scope: Read-only review of frozen benchmarks/repair-firstpass-20260921/preflight.mjs and preflight.test.mjs at base 9730d49b0984a47cdc48ac809b6c754a3057b0a5. Prior/runtime inputs and development artifact bytes were not inspected.

verified.claim: Input bytes and accepted output are protected.
verified.evidence: The CLI reads source bytes before work, rejects same canonical path plus existing symlink/hard-link aliases by device/inode, and writes --out only for accepted or unchanged results. It carries inputSha256 in reports; tests cover same path, symlink, hard-link, and source-byte preservation.

verified.claim: Semantic content and authored connection geometry cannot silently change.
verified.evidence: semanticHash removes only declared component/layout/viewBox geometry. Every connection field remains in the projection. inputProblems declines any via/channel/label geometry, non-auto route, or non-auto endpoint side before searching. Every queued candidate must retain sourceSemanticHash.

verified.claim: Acceptance is fail-closed and uses production showcase validation.
verified.evidence: Each candidate must pass layout validation and normal showcase validation. staticPass additionally requires receipt candidate SHA equality, zero composition errors/warnings, showcase profile, and every reported check ok. No output is emitted for a declined result.

verified.claim: Attempt/time limits cannot accept a late candidate.
verified.evidence: The queue stops at 64 total attempts or 20,000 ms. makeAttempt records withinTimeBudget, and accepted/unchanged return paths recheck elapsed time. The exhausted-budget test asserts a declined report with no candidate.

verified.claim: The search is stateful in the declared bounded sense.
verified.evidence: Initial deterministic seeds are based on the baseline. Further targeted/readability seeds are enqueued only from candidates whose complete diagnostic score is strictly better than bestScore; candidates are deduplicated and ordering is deterministic by parent score then sequence.
